# `gcp.spanner.backupschedule`

A backup schedule for a Cloud Spanner Database. This resource is owned by the database it is backing up, and is deleted along with the database. The actual backups are not though.

[spanner](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Service | spanner |
| Scope | global |
| Asset type | `spanner.googleapis.com/BackupSchedule` |
| Hangs off | `projects` |
| Tier | 1 (ruled: encoder (encoders/spanner_schedule_backup.go.tmpl) invents a tfgen- name when none is set, puts the full name in the body, and deletes Terraform's instance and database fields. Here name is the backup_schedule_id query parameter of the create, and Discovery says BackupSchedule.name is "Output only for the CreateBackupSchedule operation", so the body carries none. required: [name] replaces the invented one.
decoder (decoders/spanner_schedule_backup.go.tmpl) is Terraform's id bookkeeping. pre_update (pre_update/spanner_schedule_backup.go.tmpl) replaces the mask "spec" with "spec.cron_spec.text"; BuildMask masks the changed leaf, spec.cronSpec.text, the same path in JSON spelling.
) |
| Mutation timeout | 60s |

## What it can do

| Operation | Supported | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Create | yes | `POST projects/{{project}}/instances/{{instance}}/databases/{{database}}/backupSchedules?backup_schedule_id={{name}}` |
| Read | yes | `GET projects/{{project}}/instances/{{instance}}/databases/{{database}}/backupSchedules/{{name}}` |
| Update | yes | `PATCH projects/{{project}}/instances/{{instance}}/databases/{{database}}/backupSchedules/{{name}}`, with an update mask naming the changed fields |
| Delete | yes | `DELETE projects/{{project}}/instances/{{instance}}/databases/{{database}}/backupSchedules/{{name}}` |
| Import | yes | by id, see below |

## Import id

Any one of these shapes is accepted, tried in order:

```
projects/{{project}}/instances/{{instance}}/databases/{{database}}/backupSchedules/{{name}}
{{project}}/{{instance}}/{{database}}/{{name}}
{{instance}}/{{database}}/{{name}}
```
